recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的顆粒球前驅細胞（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）成熟有序、顆粒充足、核型正常，看不到明顯發育異常或母細胞增加，說明此病例的發育異常只侷限於其他系列（單系發育異常）。
features: Orderly maturing granulocytic precursors: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms
Normal abundant azurophilic/specific granulation of the cytoplasm
Normal nuclear shapes for maturation stage; no pseudo-Pelger or hypogranular forms
No blasts identified in this field
Single small dark cell consistent with a lymphocyte or late erythroblast
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing neutrophil precursors, including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, with normal granulation and appropriate nuclear maturation. Significant dysgranulopoiesis such as hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger-Huët nuclei is not present, and blasts are not increased in this field. This image documents the absence of granulocytic dysplasia, which in context supports myelodysplastic syndrome with single-lineage dysplasia involving another lineage.

ddx.vs: Distinguishing requires ≥10% dysplastic cells in the affected lineage, persistent cytopenia and exclusion of reactive causes, not granulocytic morphology alone.
MLD requires ≥10% dysplastic cells in two or more lineages, whereas granulocytes here lack dysplasia.
MDS-EB requires ≥5% marrow blasts, while blasts here are <5%.
